claim: Crossing walls alone leaves a median 8.5% of each campaign map unreachable (97% of E6M5); following room-over-room link markers (paired by data1) and kSectorTeleport destinations as well leaves a median 2.8%, never more than 13.8%, and that rest is closets, signatures and helpers.
evidence: portal-graph reachability over the 43 campaign maps, docs/blood-mechanics-and-conventions.md (removed from the working tree in the 2026-11-26 consolidation; read it at commit ea7be12); teleport via triggers.cpp OperateTeleport
use: A reachability reader must join sectors by link markers and teleports, not only by two-sided walls.
